data.one_liner: Amap SDK Flutter plugin for integrating AMapSDK in iOS and Android applications.
data.what_it_does: Integrates AMap maps into Flutter applications for Android and iOS. Provides a map widget with support for markers, polylines, polygons, camera movement, and location options.
use_when: You need to display AMap (高德地图) maps in an Android or iOS Flutter app.
You need custom markers, overlays, and camera control on AMap.
avoid_when: You need standard Google Maps without relying on AMap services.
You require robust web or desktop map support.
strengths: Supports latest AMap Android and iOS SDK versions.
Provides comprehensive control over markers, polylines, and camera positions via AMapController.
weaknesses: Requires manual API key and compliance/privacy statement setup for both Android and iOS.
Platform support is limited to Android and iOS.
data.setup_notes: Requires obtaining an API key from the AMap developer platform, configuring Android and iOS specific setup files, and initializing AMapInitializer with privacy agreement handling in code.

alternatives.name: google_maps_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you prefer Google Maps over AMap for global coverage.

alternatives.name: flutter_map
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you want an open-source map solution using OpenStreetMap tiles instead of commercial map providers.
